subject: Thatched umbrellas and loungers on a rocky shore by turquoise water
reason: The private shoreline looks its best in the water colour, but this is hard overhead light with no modelling, the foreground is taken up by timber steps and dry scrub, and a wooden bin sits in the bottom right. Strong support frame.
flagReason: A small multicoloured logo mark sits on the sand near the lower-right corner, which reads as a watermark burned into the file.

subject: Open-plan living room with kitchenette, dining table and sofa
reason: Clean, level, well-exposed interior that reads as real and usable. Flat even light, no view, a black subwoofer box on the floor and a blue plastic bag left on the dining table keep it in support territory.
flagReason: Compact studio layout, sofa bed and retro-fridge styling differ markedly from the white-and-timber villa interiors elsewhere in this set, and nothing in frame ties it to a seafront estate.

subject: Branded shower gel bottle tucked into rolled white towels

subject: Folded white towels and a wicker basket with lavender against a marble bathroom wall
reason: Soft warm light and real texture — terry towelling, wicker weave, veined marble — which makes it usable as a small supporting detail or a background block. It is weak: the bottom half dissolves into an out-of-focus towel, a cropped white basin corner intrudes at bottom-left, and the white ceramic ornament at top-left is unreadable. But none of that is a C-list defect; the light is directional and pleasant and the register is right. Support only, and small.
flagReason: A supplier's linen brand label (COCO-MAT) is legible on the towel that dominates the frame — third-party branding rather than the estate's own.
